pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: COLLECTIVE NOUNS.

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns.

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns.. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do collective nouns form their plurals?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify collective nouns from a text
2. use singular and plural forms of collective nouns correctly in sentences

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify collective nouns from a text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify collective nouns from a text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use singular and plural forms of collective nouns correctly in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can use singular and plural forms of collective nouns correctly in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns..
4. Show that you can: identify collective nouns from a text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. List the collective nouns as they listen to an audio text,
2. Discuss the plural forms of these nouns,
3. Write correct sentences using collective nouns from substitution tables,
4. Fill in blank spaces using the correct collective nouns,
5. Fill in crossword puzzles using collective nouns,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify collective nouns from a text
2. use singular and plural forms of collective nouns correctly in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
